objective: Audit semantic completeness of every terminal SAT/UNSAT outcome in the three frontier extraction streams.
method: Reconstruct each arm's three point sets from its affine bases and Frobenius exponents. Compute the reachable target set using actual Sage elliptic-curve additions only, independently of Semaev descent, CNF generation, solver output and subgroup logarithm tables.
checks: verified_relation target belongs to the group-addition reachability set
exhausted_polynomial_models target does not belong to the group-addition reachability set
timeout is classified by reachability but asserts neither SAT nor UNSAT
reported predicted coverage equals independent reachable-set cardinality
failure_policy: Any SAT/UNSAT mismatch invalidates the affected encoding/result batch and triggers a code repair; do not average it into yield results.
scope: This proves completeness only for the tested m=3 finite chained representation, factor bases and targets.
